certified.heading: Five stages, every car.
certified.lead: The certification route is the same whether the car is a AED 30,000 hatchback or a AED 200,000 SUV. Nothing is priced until it has been through all five.
certified.page_intro: [Open the Certified page here — what a buyer should understand about the checking before they read the stages. Two or three sentences.]

stages.title: Thorough inspection
stages.text: A full check of engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, electrics, air conditioning and bodywork by our own technicians.

stages.title: History report
stages.text: Registration, accident and service history pulled and read before the car is accepted for sale. Anything unclear is declined.

stages.title: Reconditioning
stages.text: Wear items replaced and faults corrected at Vesla Auto Service Center using genuine parts, not the cheapest available.

stages.title: Certification
stages.text: The car is signed off under the Vesla Certified Pre Owned label, with the inspection record handed to the buyer.

stages.title: Warranty
stages.text: An extended warranty is offered on eligible cars, serviceable at our own centre rather than a third-party workshop.

why.heading: What a certified car actually buys you.

cards.title: Inspected, not just cleaned
cards.text: Every major system is checked and recorded before a price goes on the windscreen. You are handed the inspection, not asked to trust it.

cards.title: A documented history
cards.text: Registration, accident and service records are pulled and read. If the history is unclear, the car does not join the stock.

cards.title: Genuine parts, our technicians
cards.text: Reconditioning and warranty work is done at Vesla Auto Service Center by technicians who work on these cars daily, using genuine parts.

cards.title: The rest of the group behind it
cards.text: Service, leasing, rental and resale all sit under the same owner. When your needs change, you move companies rather than suppliers.

record.heading: Thirty-six years on the same street corner of the trade.
record.lead: Vesla Motors is the retail end of the group’s automotive platform. It has been trading in Dubai since 1988, and it does one thing: buy good used cars, put them right, and sell them with the paperwork to prove it.
record.page_intro: [Open the About page here — the one thing about thirty-six years on the same street that a buyer should take away. Two or three sentences.]
record.note: Founding year, branch count and the Dubizzle Top Dealer award are taken from veslamotors.com. Annual sales volume is described there as “thousands of cars annually” and is not stated as a figure, so it is not shown here.

chairman.heading: One owner, thirty-six years.
chairman.text: Vesla Motors is the retail end of the automotive platform held by MRM Investment LLC, and it has traded in Dubai under the same ownership since 1988. Service, leasing, rental and resale sit under that same roof — which is why a car bought here can be serviced, re-leased or sold back without ever leaving the group.
chairman.note: Name and title as published on veslamotors.com. No statement from the chairman and no portrait are quoted here because neither has been supplied.

sell.heading: We buy cars too.
sell.lead: Thirty-six years of buying means we know what a car is worth in this market, and we would rather make you a straight offer than haggle you down.
sell.page_intro: [Open the Sell your car page here — why somebody should bring a car to Vesla rather than sell it privately. Two or three sentences.]
sell.body: Bring the car to either branch for a physical valuation, or start with the estimator here to get a sense of the range before you drive over. Trade-ins are set against anything on the floor.
sell.note: The estimator is a demonstration model, not a quotation. A real valuation follows a physical inspection at a branch.
sell.est_sub: Indicative range only — no personal details required.
sell.est_note: Demonstration figures based on sample stock, not a valuation of your vehicle. Confirmed only after inspection at a Vesla Motors branch.
sell.est_send_title: Want us to look at it properly?

items.q: What does a Vesla Certified Pre Owned car include?
items.a: Every car passes a five-stage route: a full mechanical and bodywork inspection, a registration, accident and service history report, reconditioning with genuine parts at Vesla Auto Service Center, certification with the inspection record handed to the buyer, and an extended warranty on eligible cars.

items.q: Does Vesla Motors buy used cars in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Bring the car to either UAE branch for a physical valuation, or use the online estimator for an indicative range first. Trade-ins can be set against any car in stock.

items.q: How long has Vesla Motors been trading?
items.a: Vesla Motors has traded in Dubai since 1988 under the same ownership, and has been named a Dubizzle Top Dealer for three consecutive years.
